deviations: M6b interpretation: 'compare high-water counters against the live store' is implemented as BOTH a semantic-integrity check (manifest HighWater must equal the backup DB's actual contents, catching a tampered DB with a recomputed hash) AND an anti-rollback check (a backup whose deletion/tombstone/node-revision high-water is BELOW the live store is refused as a pre-deletion rollback). The latter refuses restoring an older snapshot outright; docs/recovery.md was updated to state this. Forward/forward_spec counts are NOT compared against live because they are not monotone facts.
L3 'corrupted JSON' RED test uses an ENOTDIR stateDir for the quarantine ambiguity (recovery.quarantine is an existence marker, not a JSON resource) — the fail-closed path is exercised the same way.

The M3a ForceDeleteNode session-termination callback is variadic so the two existing lifecycle tests keep compiling; no production caller exists yet (P15 owns the API), so Hub.ForceCloseNodeSession is provided for that wiring.
